title: The Night Shift
logline: On steep, misted hill roads, an ambulance crew races between a district hospital and villages that are sometimes twenty minutes away and sometimes two hours, and every call is a small argument with time.

object.note: Object 8 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: From what a death leaves behind to how fragile a life is before it ends: an ambulance crew on misted hill roads, arguing with time on every call.

thread_out.thread: When speed has done what it can, someone still comes: a village monk walking to house after house where someone is close to death.

A crew willing to be followed for at least one full shift
